verdict.rationale: Conductor's changelog introduces "routines" that run agents on a schedule or via a GitHub Action, and its cloud sandboxes keep agents working after you close your laptop. Cloud agents can also act without per-step confirmation, and the API can create workspaces and send prompts programmatically. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of routines (configuration, triggers, notifications, failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled or background runs.
